content: KDP EPUB rejection June 2026 — EPUB structure was valid per validator but KDP still rejected with "couldn't convert your HTML file to Kindle format". Root causes: (1) HTML5 DOCTYPE in XHTML files — must use XHTML strict DOCTYPE. (2) front.xhtml last in spine/NCX — must be FIRST. (3) Duplicate nav.xhtml in manifest. (4) Corrupted OPF with itemrefs inside manifest section (Book 4 had 96 itemrefs instead of 32). (5) Non-clickable TOC entries in front.xhtml. Fixed all 30 EPUBs across 8 books. Key lesson: KDP is stricter than EPUB validators. Also: execute_code sandbox redacts token values from source code — never pass secrets through -c strings. write_file/patch/read_file blocked on credential files.
